questions.prompt: Match each MCP participant to its role.

pairs.right: The AI application, like Claude Desktop or Claude Code
The connection the host keeps for each server
The program that provides tools, resources, and prompts

questions.explanation: A host creates one client per server; each server exposes context and capabilities.

questions.prompt: Why must a stdio MCP server never print to stdout?

options.text: stdout carries the JSON-RPC protocol messages, so extra output corrupts them
Claude reads stdout as user instructions

questions.explanation: In stdio servers, stdout is the protocol channel. Log with the logging module, which writes to stderr.

questions.prompt: MCP's transport for remote servers that serve many clients is called Streamable ____.
questions.explanation: Streamable HTTP uses HTTP POST with optional Server-Sent Events; stdio is the local transport.

questions.prompt: Which are primitives an MCP server can expose? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Servers expose tools, resources, and prompts. Sampling was a client primitive, and it's deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

questions.prompt: Order the steps to build and use a local MCP server with Claude Desktop.

items.text: Add it under mcpServers in claude_desktop_config.json with absolute paths
Write tools as typed, documented functions with @mcp.tool()
Restart Claude Desktop and ask Claude to use the tool
Create the project and install the MCP SDK (uv add "mcp[cli]")

questions.explanation: Set up the project, write the tools, register the server in the Desktop config with absolute paths, then restart and test.

questions.prompt: What does a remote server need before you add it as a claude.ai custom connector?

options.text: A publicly reachable URL and appropriate authentication, ideally OAuth
Nothing; claude.ai can't use remote servers

questions.explanation: Claude connects from Anthropic's cloud, so the server must be internet-reachable, and MCP recommends OAuth for authentication.
